title: Cohomology concentration of the vector-bundle integration source
statement: Under the hypotheses and constructions of [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], H^q(C_pi) is zero for every integer q different from zero. This is a vanishing assertion only and does not construct any global integration map.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: Choose the normalized affine trace data and a finite locally free frame cover. Each local exchange and coefficient comparison is an isomorphism and the affine counit is an isomorphism.
The constant single complex has zero cohomology in degrees other than zero. Exact inverse image and its mapDerivedCategory comparison transport this vanishing to the inverse image of H^q(C_pi).
Apply the proved ModuleCat version of jointly surjective étale inverse-image conservativity to the morphism H^q(C_pi)→0. Thus this morphism is an isomorphism and its source is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem vectorIntegration_cohomology_zero (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (q : ℤ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
      (vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F))
